name: Kidnapping Love
source:
The main character and a few of his fellow villagers get kidnapped by a mysterious warrior. It's his / her decision whatever happens after that.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=8715]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
主人公与几名同村人被一名神秘战士绑架。之后会发生什么，全由玩家的选择决定。
